name: Intercom notifier
author: mattw
description: See Intercom conversations waiting for a reply, and reply as yourself.

barWidget.description: Waiting and open Intercom conversation counts, with a reader that can send a teammate reply.

schema.label: Access token file
schema.description: Optional path to a file containing your Intercom OAuth access token. Defaults to ~/.config/omarchy/omarchy-intercom-client/token. The INTERCOM_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable wins if set.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to poll Intercom for conversations waiting for a reply.
